notes.title: Update and free DLC
notes.notes:
Hi everyone

As we want to improve the experience for all players, we have released an update which improve the usability for blind players. The new update adds audio feedback to the menu, for a better blind experience.

Dark Passenger first DLC will be released next week. It will include a map that can be activated 5 seconds per level to help players struggling to beat the game.

notes.title: End of early access
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

We want to communicate two bits of news related to Dark Passenger. 

Firstly, the early access will end the 26 April 2017 and we want to thank all the people who have played our game and help us to improve. 

Secondly, as we come to the end of early access, Dark Passenger's price has changed to reflect the full release and will now be sold at $1.99.
